def match_pattern(s, t):
    n, m = len(s), len(t)
    
    # Find the position of the wildcard '*'
    star_index = s.find('*')
    
    if star_index == -1:
        # No wildcard, s must be exactly equal to t
        return s == t
    
    # Check if the prefix before '*' matches
    if s[:star_index] != t[:star_index]:
        return False
    
    # Check if the suffix after '*' matches
    if s[star_index + 1:] != t[m - (n - star_index - 1):]:
        return False
    
    # Check if the length of t is sufficient to accommodate the wildcard
    return m >= n - 1
